title: t3dotgg/tstack
why_read: A personal collection of AI coding agent skill configurations for Claude Code and Codex, useful as a reference but not a deep technical contribution.
analysis: This repository shares one developer's personal set of 'agent skills,' essentially prompt/config snippets, for use with AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex. It's a practical, shareable artifact for people experimenting with agentic coding workflows, reflecting the growing ecosystem around customizing these tools. The value is mostly as a template or inspiration rather than as novel engineering, so interest is moderate and tied to current AI-tooling trends.
